summary: The legend entry joins chart.geometry.json as case chart-legend-entry, extracted from the Legend toggle sheet's Shown entry: 62×24, insets 4 block and 8 inline, an 8px key 4px from the name. To make it measurable the geometry test now looks for a case's children inside its container rather than across the document, which a legend (two entries at least) had made impossible; every existing case still passes. The entry moves from a fixed 24px height to 4px block padding with a 24px floor, so its inset is declared rather than produced by centring, and the key carries data-slot="chart-legend-key".
